text: As the Patriots limp into Miami for a Week 8 matchup against the Dolphins on Sunday, November 1st at 4:15 PM ET, they're nursing the wounds of a 30-24 loss to the Bears in Chicago, where Caleb Williams outdueled Drake Maye in what amounted to Round 2 between the young quarterbacks. The organization made some modest roster adjustments this week, re-signing LB Jose Ramirez to the practice squad while releasing OL Jacob Rizy from the same unit and P Bryce Baringer from injured reserve, though these moves feel like triage rather than transformation. The film review reveals troubling issues beyond the box score—Mike Vrabel's emphasis on turnover differential, one of his four pillars of team identity, has become a glaring weakness for New England, and with Drake Maye still finding his footing against NFL talent, the Patriots have their work cut out against a division rival. Meanwhile, running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues to do the dirty work that doesn't always show up on highlight reels, approaching his sixth straight 100-carry season, which is perhaps the only encouraging sign heading into South Florida.
